subtitle.en: The island is basically settled now, so here is one more look at it.
subtitle.zh: 岛上的样子基本定下来了，于是再发一张看看。

translator.note: 原文出自 Orsi Spanyol。源文件为 2015-003-island-snapshot.md（manifest 里该 id 的 mdPath）。缩略图包链接按全站约定收为图片占位段落。

blocks.en: It seems like a good time to do one of these, since the island is pretty much all figured out! We have been wrapping up a lot of big tasks, working on some cool effects, and doing a bit of polishing and bugfixing. While we still have some things to finish, the island is probably not going to visibly change much anymore.
blocks.zh: 现在发这么一篇似乎正是时候，因为这座岛基本上已经全部定下来了！我们一直在收尾一大堆大任务、做一些很酷的效果，还做了些打磨和修 bug 的活。虽然还有些东西要收尾，但岛的外观大概不会再有多大变化了。
